newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's says to consolidate Tunica May 19.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's says to consolidate Tunica May 19.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc said it plans to complete a consolidation of its operations in Tunica, Miss., into its newer and larger Harrah's Tunica Mardi Gras Casino and Hotel on Monday, May 19 at 0600 EST.
The announcemment completes a previously announced plan to have an exit strategy for its original Tunica casino by mid-year.

The company anticipates the consolidation will include transfer of the entire current Harrah's Tunica staff to the Mardi Gras Casino and the movement of the most popular slot machines into the newer Harrah's property. Harrah's anticipates no layoffs due to the consolidation.
